PROYECTS.TITLE: Not just ideas, but facts.
PROYECTS.DESCRIPTION: These are some of the projects I have developed

items.title: NeuroScreen
items.subtitle: Early detection of alcoholism through EEG analysis and machine learning
items.description: Developed in Flask, NeuroScreen is a web application that enables early detection of alcohol use disorders through EEG data analysis and machine learning. The application offers features such as user authentication, patient management, EEG file upload for real-time predictions, and a dashboard with interpretability visualization.
items.problem: Need for accessible clinical tools for early detection of alcohol use disorders using neurological biomarkers.
features: Login/Logout with JWT and session persistence
EEG file upload and real-time predictions

items.title: LeetCode Clone
items.subtitle: Programming exercises platform inspired by LeetCode
items.description: A web application for testing exercises, built using Flask and inspired by LeetCode. It allows users to solve programming problems, submit solutions, and view their results.
items.problem: Create a local environment for algorithm practice with code editor and automatic solution evaluation.
features: Code editor with submit and automatic evaluation

items.title: CaliNema
items.subtitle: Real-time cinema billboard for Cali
items.description: Developed in Astro, CaliNema is a prototype website that displays all current movies and showtimes available in Cali's cinemas. Movie information is obtained through the CaliNema API.
items.problem: Need for a centralized platform to check local movie releases and showtimes in real time.
features: Real-time data consumption from CaliNema API
Movie listing with details and showtimes

items.title: CaliNema API
items.subtitle: Backend for Cali cinema billboard data
items.description: Developed in Django REST Framework, the CaliNema API performs web scraping of the five major cinemas in Cali to obtain all available movies and showtimes.
items.problem: Centralize and normalize cinema billboard data scattered across multiple websites.
features: Automated web scraping of cinema websites

items.title: Pokédex 3D
items.subtitle: Interactive explorer with 3D models
items.description: A web application developed with Vite and React that uses the PokéAPI to display detailed information about various Pokémon. It integrates React Three Fiber to render 3D models and elements with a dynamic visual experience.
items.problem: Create an interactive Pokémon exploration experience with modern 3D visualization.
features: 3D rendering with Three.js and React Three Fiber

items.title: RadioApp
items.subtitle: Global radio station explorer
items.description: A web application built with Vite and React that uses the Radio Browser public API to display radio stations from around the world. Highlights Colombian stations on the homepage.
items.problem: Provide a centralized and simple interface to discover and play live radio stations.
features: Search stations by country and genre

items.title: X-Ray Classification
items.subtitle: Automatic classification system using deep learning
items.description: Repository with a machine learning project focused on automatic chest X-ray classification using convolutional neural networks (CNN) and transfer learning models (VGG16 and ResNet50).
items.problem: Automate pathology detection and classification in chest X-rays for clinical second opinions.

items.title: MenuUSB
items.subtitle: University store menu portal
items.description: Developed in Django, MenuUSB is a website that allows viewing all menus from the stores of San Buenaventura University in one place, facilitating daily consultation.
items.problem: Centralize menu information distributed among multiple university stores.

items.title: Elite Democracy
items.subtitle: Educational analysis of democratic systems
items.description: Website developed as an academic project on constitution and democracy. Describes characteristics and provides examples of elite democracy with structured educational content.
items.problem: Present complex concepts of political science in a clear and accessible way for students.
